resources.string: Shown when the linked app is focused in the first dock row. A bad address, unusable JSON, or a timeout keeps the built-in shelf for that app when one exists.

The address must return a JSON array of objects with title, meta, and an http or https image. At most 12 items are kept. Jellyfin and Emby do not return this shape; use a small proxy in front of them.
Enter an http or https address
Choose which dock app shows this shelf. OK on that tile still opens the app.
Removes the address and the linked app.
